what_is.heading: What is Professional Teeth Whitening?
paragraphs: Dramatically brighten your smile and boost your confidence with our professional Teeth Whitening services. Over time, teeth can become stained and yellowed from coffee, tea, red wine, smoking, and the natural aging process. Professional whitening is the safest and most effective way to lift these stains and reveal a brilliantly white smile.

options.heading: Your Whitening Options
paragraphs: At LUNAI, we offer two convenient and powerful options. Our in-office whitening treatment provides the most dramatic results in a single visit, often lightening teeth by several shades in about an hour. We also provide custom take-home whitening kits. We create custom-fitted trays that ensure the professional-strength whitening gel is applied evenly and safely for you to use at home.

results.heading: Safe and Superior Results
paragraphs: Both of our whitening solutions are safe for your enamel and provide results far superior to over-the-counter products. Let us help you achieve the dazzling, white smile you've always wanted.
